metadata.title: Full 3D Drosophila Melanogaster Visible Exoskeleton & FlyWire Connectome
metadata.source: FlyWire Whole-Brain Consortium (Nature 2024) & Janelia MaleCNS v1.0

provenance.rationale: Authentic EM-derived SWC morphologies, presynaptic partner segregations, and nanometer synapse cloud

neurons.functional_role: Rightward motion detection (ON edge coincidence & shunting)
Non-delayed fast central excitation to T4 shaft
Trailing delayed excitation (τ=60ms) producing supralinear coincidence
Null-direction proximal shunting inhibition (Rdl/Grd GABA receptors)
Heading compass representation (E-PG activity bump tracks fly orientation in Doom)
Descending ballistic weapon discharge and stance stabilization trigger
